Great potential - completely underwhelming. …arrived at 8pm for a qui
Apr 2026 • Couples
There were only 4 other very small groups in the bar/restaurant. It was 8pm, music was just right for the number of people in the area. They only had one of the three beers on offer. We opted for Gin & Tonic from the totally unresponsive waiter. 
Once the drinks arrived we wanted to order our dinner and we were told couldn’t order food!
We asked for the bill which was incorrect! How can you get two G&T’s wrong?
The music by this time had been turned up to a volume that meant you could no longer hear yourself think! I am guessing the reason for the almost nonexistent patronage is due to the inability to read the room or provide what you are there to do. I really hope they improve as the potential is really there

Stylish and Artsy Gem in Hà Nội
Sep 2023 • Couples
Stumbled over this place place by chance while strolling the busy streets of Hà Nöi and could not be more happy with our find.

A fantastic lounge and easy place to unwind. The place gives good vibes and if we did not have prior commitments for the evening, we would have gladly extended our stay a while longer listening away to the great tunes.

The service was ever so friendly and helpful. They even took the time helping us to book our taxi and escorted us to the car. Wow !!!

The cocktails they serve are their original creations and coffee is simply perfect and delicious. If you have time you can also have a lovely afternoon tea set.

It is an oasis of calm where to chill out away from Hà Nội summer heat. You will not regret spending time there. We are hoping to be back soon !

Best cocktails we have had in Ha Noi
Jul 2023 • Couples
We had planned on a few cocktails before our dinner, and headed to Tach Spaces. After waiting to enter while Instagrammers blocked the entrance we finally found the cocktail bar to be told it didn't open until 1830 (despite being open elsewhere). We tried to get a drink in another part but disinterested staff put us off. Feeling a bit down we headed into the street and as luck would have it bumped into SI Cuisine and Mixology.

It was a lucky accident. It was early so pretty quiet. Staff took good care of us and gave us a great window seat. The cocktails take some time to prepare (as they should) but they were spectacular. We tried four different ones (two each of course...) - I started with a "Si Fashioned" which was very good but the "Penicillin" (complete with smoke filled presentation container was amazing. Worth it for this one alone. The missus had a Margarita (can't remember actual name) with chili salt which had quite a chili kick (just what the missus likes) and finished with a "Ramos Gin Fizz". Both were excellent.

The decor is spectacular, the staff were attentive without being intrusive. It's a bit pricey but worth it.

This is an amazing place and we'll be back to try the food one night as well.

If We Were Younger...
Nov 2022
... we would most likely have spent the night in this posh bar/lounge. As it is we only spent the blue hour here on an inside table but directly at one of their open floor to ceiling windows and enjoyed watching people go by and our drinks...

My favourite was not on the menu - a good old Whiskey Sour - and I had already opted for their Negroni. But noticing my "disappointment" the young waiter came back a few minutes later and told me that his colleague at the bar had agreed to prepare a real Whiskey Sour with Bourbon and even an egg white.
